scripts.dev: node scripts/check-node.js && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-warnings" tsx server.ts
scripts.build:windows:local: npm run build:executor && npm run build:server && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.local.conf.json --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:macos:local: npm run build:executor && npm run build:server && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.local.conf.json --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:executor && npm run build:server
scripts.build:test: npm run build:executor && npm run build:server && tauri build
scripts.test:server: node scripts/check-node.js && npm run build:executor && tsx --test src/features/contest/contest-file.test.ts src/features/judging/judge-results.test.ts src/features/judging/availability.test.ts src/features/desktop/browser-lifecycle.test.ts src/features/workspace/path-memory.test.ts src/features/workspace/selection-state.test.ts server/judge/standard-checkers.test.ts server/judge/custom-checker-runner.test.ts server/judge/scoring.test.ts server/judge/discovery.test.ts server/judge/compiler.test.ts server/judge/execution-request.test.ts server/judge/python-runtime.test.ts server/judge/python-submission.test.ts server/judge/resource-policy.test.ts server/languages/contracts.test.ts server/problems/problem-config.test.ts server/platform/directory-picker.test.ts server/platform/parent-watchdog.test.ts server/sandbox/detection.test.ts server/sandbox/path-mapping.test.ts server/executor/client.test.ts server/executor/verdict-mapper.test.ts server/routes/toolchain-routes.test.ts src/components/JudgingDetailsModal.test.tsx src/features/problem-config/editor-state.test.ts src/features/export/score-workbook.test.ts src/features/preferences/storage.test.ts src/features/toolchains/ToolchainManager.test.tsx scripts/build-server-target.test.js scripts/generate-updater-manifest.test.js server/toolchains/resolver.test.ts server/toolchains/manifest.test.ts server/toolchains/installer.test.ts
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:server && node scripts/prepare-desktop-dev.js && cross-env DISABLE_HMR=true tauri dev --no-watch
